Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ajay - 28 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Neeta - 55 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Anita - 28 years, friend
Look: green saree
4. Nitin - 31 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The temple - stone pillars, a big bell
3. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Ajay stands by the road. Neeta and Nitin stand near him.]

Ajay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ajay starts his scooter and rides off.]

Ajay (gently): "And then?"

[Ajay drives the car to the office.]

Ajay (softly): "That's great!"

[Ajay rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Nitin: "I'm ready!"

[The thug's knife wounds Ajay in the stomach; he doubles over.]

Ajay: "Yes, of course."

[Ajay withdraws cash from the ATM.]

Ajay (gently): "What happened?"

[Ajay counts the notes and puts them in his wallet.]

Ajay: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 2: The temple - Day

Ajay: "What a nice place."

[Ajay rings the temple bell.]

Neeta: "Ajay, look at this."

[Ajay folds his hands and prays.]

Neeta: "Exactly right."

[Ajay kneels before the idol.]

Ajay: "Mom, listen!"

Scene 3: The hospital ward - Day

[Ajay is asleep in bed in the ward. Neeta, Anita and Nitin stand near him.]

Anita: "Let's begin."

[After a long illness Ajay passes away in his hospital bed.]

Neeta (happily): "No… this cannot be!"
